from PyPDF2 import PdfWriter

# Create PDF writer
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_blank_page(width=612, height=792)  # Letter size in points

# Email 1: vendor@vendor.com - Original draft notification
email1 = """
===== ORIGINAL EMAIL =====
From: vendor@vendor.com
Subject: Contract X draft
Date: Mon, Oct 3

Please see the attached draft and comment.

Regards,
Vendor Team
==========================
"""

# Email 2: leadnegotiator - Discussion notes  
email2 = """
===== EMAIL 2 =====
From: leadnegotiator@company.com
Subject: Re: Contract X - discussion and notes
Date: Oct 10, 09:12

Hi,

Thanks for the updates. I'm pasting the thread below for reference.

-----Original Message-----
From: vendor@vendor.com
Date: Mon, Oct 3
Subject: Contract X draft
Please see the attached draft and comment.

-----Original Reply-----
PRIVILEGED: ATTORNEY-CLIENT - DO NOT PRODUCE.

Best,
Sam
==========================
"""

# Email 3: Legal assistant - Compiled bundles
email3 = """
===== EMAIL 3 =====
From: legal-assistant@company.com
Subject: Contract X: compiled bundles (full and redacted)
Date: Oct 10, 10:05

Hi team,

I've prepared two versions of the Contract X bundle for counsel.
One is an unmodified bundle containing all thread items; the other omits the privilege-marked message.

Included in correspondence:
- ContractX_bundle_all.pdf (full bundle)
- ContractX_bundle_redacted.pdf (bundle with privileged message omitted)  
- ContractX_draft.docx (original draft)

--- END OF CORRESPONDENCE ---
==========================
"""

# Add each email as a separate page
for email_content in [email1, email2, email3]:
    lines = email_content.strip().split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        writer.add_text_string(line)
        writer.move_to_end(right=True)
    writer.add_page()

# Export the PDF
with open('/workspace/CONSOLIDATED_CONTRACTX_BUNDLE.pdf', 'wb') as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("Created: CONSOLIDATED_CONTRACTX_BUNDLE.pdf")

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
import os

def create_email_page(canvas, page_num, content_lines, y_start=750, y_step=30):
    """Create a PDF page with email content"""
    cs = canvas
    cs.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 14)
    cs.drawString(72, y_start - y_step, f"EMAIL {page_num}")
    cs.setFont("Helvetica", 12)
    
    y = y_start
    for line in content_lines:
        y -= y_step
        if y < 100:
            break
        cs.drawString(72, y, line)

# Create consolidated PDF
output_path = os.path.join('/workspace', 'CONSOLIDATED_CONTRACTX_BUNDLE.pdf')
consolidated_canvas = canvas.Canvas(output_path, pagesize=letter)

# Email 1

]
create_email_page(consolidated_canvas, 1, email1_lines)
